title: Electroacupuncture Treatment Protocol for Sub-Acutely Aging Rats
author: Jianmin Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ky8cxzw

steps.title: Insert needles at acupoints
steps.instruction: Insert sterile acupuncture needles to a depth of 2 mm: perpendicularly into the muscle layer at Guanyuan (CV 4) and at Zusanli (ST 36), and horizontally into the subgaleal tissue at Baihui (DU 20).

substeps.instruction: Insert needle at CV 4 perpendicularly to muscle layer, depth 2 mm.
Insert needle at ST 36 perpendicularly to muscle layer, depth 2 mm (bilateral, to be used alternately).
Insert needle at DU 20 horizontally into subgaleal tissue, depth 2 mm.

steps.title: Connect electrodes and set EA parameters
steps.instruction: Attach the CV 4 needle to the negative pole and the ST 36 needles (alternating bilaterally) to the positive pole of the pulse generator, then configure the device to continuous wave, 2 Hz frequency, 1 mA intensity, and run electroacupuncture for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Connect CV 4 needle to negative charge.
Connect ST 36 needles (alternating sides) to positive charge.
Set pulse generator: continuous wave, 2 Hz, 1 mA.

steps.title: Rotate DU20 needle manually
steps.instruction: While the DU 20 needle remains in place, twirl and rotate it forward and backward continuously at 2–3 rotations per second for 30 seconds.

substeps.instruction: After DU 20 needle placement, rotate needle 2–3 times per second for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Repeat rotation and withdraw needles
steps.instruction: Repeat the DU 20 needle rotation every 5 minutes, performing three repetitions total, then remove all needles.

substeps.instruction: Perform the same rotation manipulation at 5‑minute intervals, three times.
After the final manipulation, withdraw all needles.

steps.title: Schedule daily EA sessions
steps.instruction: Conduct the entire electroacupuncture procedure each day except Sundays, continuing for a total of 27 days.

substeps.instruction: Perform the above steps daily, skipping Sundays.
